prompt: An open clearing ringed by tall trees, seen in a first-person view at standing eye height. On the left, a dirt road with cart ruts runs out of the clearing and rises into the trees. On the right, a small building of old handmade brick stands at the edge of the clearing, with an open wooden door facing the clearing. A small stream flows out of the base of the brick building on the right, crosses the clearing and runs down a gully in the foreground. Straight ahead, a gap between the tree trunks opens into the deeper forest. Soft daylight from the sky above lights the clearing and the trees. The ground of the clearing is open grass and dirt. The picture fills the whole frame, edge to edge. Setting: a medieval fantasy world; everything is old and handmade: weathered stone and old brick, rough timber, wrought iron. Style: 1970s comic book art: bold black ink outlines, hand-inked hatching, flat printed colours with visible halftone dots, slightly off-register colour printing, muted earthy palette of browns, ochres, olive and amber, on aged newsprint. Mood: quiet, still and mysterious, a place long left alone.
